id: title:charlesvien:stop re parsing a whole streaming message per frame

review.posthog_relevance: Adds shared React utility hooks for state management and message parsing, potentially supporting frontend query rendering or event stream processing.
review.reason: Adds three shared React utility hooks: useRecentlyChanged, useThrottledValue, and useStreamingTail. P1.F6.H1 and P1.F8.H1 implement state change and throttling logic; P1.F3.H4 implements message tail parsing. P1.F4.H3 and P1.F5.H1 are dependent consumers or tests. This is a localized, shared utility implementation without demonstrated systemic impact or critical path dependency.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation and dependent usage are not fully visible; the chunk relies on other hunks. No tests or broader integration are shown. No evidence of production benefit or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the referenced shared utilities. P1.F3.H4 and P1.F3.H5 depend on P1.F6.H1 and P1.F8.H1, and P1.F4.H3 depends on P1.F5.H1. P1.F5.H1 and P1.F7.H1 are tests, P1.F6.H1 and P1.F8.H1 are the actual implementations. P1.F3.H4 and P1.F3.H5 also depend on P1.F6.H1 and P1.F8.H1. P1.F4.H3 depends on P1.F5.H1.
